Product_Name: Kasa Indoor Pan/Tilt Smart Security Camera, 1080p HD Dog-Camera,2.4GHz with Night Vision,Motion Detection for Baby and Pet Monitor, Cloud & SD Card Storage, Works with Alexa& Google Home (EC70), White
Ai_text: Customers like the value, ease of setup, and picture quality of the security camera. For example, they mention it's a worthwhile investment, has clear video and sound, and is easy to connect with the app. That said, opinions are mixed on quality, performance, and motion detection.
Description:
Get the full picture of any space in your apartment, dorm or home with the Kasa Spot Pan Tilt. Receive instant alerts and live stream 1080p HD video to your smartphone, Alexa or Google Assistant supported display. The Spot even provides HD video up to 30 ft. with Night Vision. EC70 continuously records and stores footage on a local MicroSD card up to 256 GB (MicroSD card not included).
Premium cloud storage options are available.
